courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 厄勒海峽大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「伶仃洋環境與設計基準」與「風洞試驗與渦激振動」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；厄勒海峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Lingdingyang conditions and design basis" and "Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Oresund Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 120 年設計壽命、大型化預製與颱風季風險管理，完成約 22.9 公里跨海橋梁；厄勒海峽大橋則以在零阻水的環境約束下，以整跨預製與浮吊安裝完成公路鐵路雙層斜張橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on delivering about 22.9 km of sea-crossing bridge with a 120-year design life, large-scale prefabrication and typhoon-season risk management; Oresund Bridge centres on building a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed crossing by full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection under a zero-blocking constraint, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「颱風與 120 年設計基準」與「橋墩阻水斷面」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到厄勒海峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Typhoon and 120-year design basis” and “Pier blockage cross-section”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Oresund Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rail loads, braking and dynamic response", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 港珠澳大橋橋梁段
history.text: 連接香港、珠海與澳門的跨伶仃洋通道經多年研究後，主體工程於 2009 年 12 月 15 日開工，以橋、島、隧結合的方案同時滿足航運、香港機場空域與 120 年設計壽命的要求。橋梁段大量採用大型化、工廠化與整體吊裝，三座通航孔斜張橋與非通航孔連續梁在 2016 年 9 月全面貫通；2018 年 2 月全線完工，10 月 23 日舉行開通儀式，24 日通車。其工程意義在於以工業化製造與嚴格的颱風季風險管理，在繁忙航道上完成約 22.9 公里的跨海橋梁，並建立三地共同管理的營運模式。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計或施工文件。
history.textEn: After years of study, main works on the crossing of the Lingdingyang between Hong Kong, Zhuhai and Macao began on 15 December 2009, with a bridge–island–tunnel scheme meeting shipping needs, Hong Kong airport airspace limits and a 120-year design life. The bridge works relied heavily on large-scale, factory-made components and single-piece lifts, and the three channel cable-stayed bridges and viaduct spans were all connected in September 2016; the whole project was completed in February 2018, opened ceremonially on 23 October and to traffic on 24 October 2018. Its engineering significance lies in building about 22.9 km of sea-crossing bridge across busy shipping lanes through industrialised fabrication and strict typhoon-season risk management, and in a jointly managed operating model for three jurisdictions. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design or construction documents.
